take_homes: Start with one agent and one good prompt. Split only for different access, dialect or stance.

Make agents draft and propose, and put a human approval before any action on another system.

misconception.why: They said outright that one agent is the default and splitting has costs. Later they admitted the audit does not check whether the output is true. That is not the last three programmes' tone. I still don't know if it lasts beyond this session, so I am not changed.

one_line: Better than I expected: it spends most of its time telling you when not to use the thing, which the other programmes never did. I'd still want to see it work on a real task of mine before I believe it.
